profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Front-end, Full-stack, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Python, FastAPI | US Army Veteran
profile.summary:
Award-winning Staff Frontend Engineer with a decade of building mission-critical systems for the U.S. federal government. Led OAuth 2.0 authentication modernization at VA.gov, delivering significant cost savings to the Department of Veterans Affairs, serving millions of Veterans worldwide.

Currently driving the automated PII/PHI mitigation controls initiative across the Department of Veterans Affairs and continued support in modernization efforts of the VA.gov platform.

Army Veteran. 2025 FedID Best Technical Advancement award, Dept. of Veterans Affairs.

Stack: React | JavaScript/TypeScript | Node.js | Next.js | Python | Github Actions

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading NIST/HIPAA PII/PHI mitigation initiative across the VA enterprise — conducting gap analysis across privacy, security, and engineering teams and helped author an Architecture Decision Record defining automated detection controls impacting 16,000 VA employees
- Driving VA.gov's phased sign-in modernization by deprecating two legacy credential providers and implementing OAuth 2.0, delivering significant cost savings to the Department of Veterans Affairs
- Migrated VA.gov's 100-app frontend monorepo from Webpack 5 to Rspack, cutting build time from 12 minutes to 46 seconds and peak heap memory from 21 GB to 6 GB — improving CI costs and developer velocity across all frontend teams
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · GitHub Copilot · Solution Architecture

positions.title: Lead Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
2025 FedID Award Winner for Best Technical Advancement at the Department of Veterans Affairs

- Develops a system-wide terms of use application that tracks users interaction with terms of use throughout the VA ecosystem in an effort to reduce bad actors and fraud
- Systematically improves VA applications’ identity and access management onboarding by architecting a self-service dashboard using Next.js, React, Chakra UI, and Ruby on Rails
- Mentors multiple engineers in JavaScript, React, and Frontend engineering best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · State Management · Software Development · Performance Improvement · Redux.js · RESTful WebServices · Software Configuration Management · REST APIs · Code Review · Authentication Systems · Project Development · Section 508 · JavaScript · Problem Solving · JavaScript Frameworks · Web Applications · Next.js · Product Delivery · Technical Leadership · Programming · Product Design · Front-End Development · React.js · English · Hands-on Technical · Version Control · Written Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrates and launches OAuth 2.0 on VA.gov effectively reducing the number of redirects by 50% without degradation to co-existing SAML authentication system
- Collaborates with DevOps and Identity teams to write and implement Github Actions for automated application building, testing, release, and deployments in a secure environment using YAML, Kubernetes, and ArgoCD.
- Works with internal marketing design team to launch two website rebrands for Clarity Innovations, LLC and Carbon Reach using JavaScript, React, Gatsby, TailwindCSS, and Jenkins.
- Successfully develops, launches and maintains Department of Veterans Affairs authentication services for VA.gov (OSS) website using JavaScript, React, Redux, and Ruby on Rails serving over 9 million users.
- Creates dashboard web application tracking test credentials using JavaScript, React, Gatsby, and the VA Design System.
- Develops user interface (UI) components for a cyber security client's analytics platform by implementing designs as part of company's design system using JavaScript, Vue, and Vuex.
- Provides oversight through code and design reviews for feature delivered by other developers within the development team.
- Uses Figma to create wireframes and mockups for usability and user experience testing
positions.insights: Skills: State Management · Software Development · Performance Improvement · Redux.js · RESTful WebServices · Software Configuration Management · REST APIs · SASS · Code Review · Authentication Systems · Github Actions · Project Development · Section 508 · JavaScript · Problem Solving · JavaScript Frameworks · Web Applications · Product Delivery · Technical Leadership · Programming · Tailwind CSS · Product Design · Front-End Development · React.js · English · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Hands-on Technical · Version Control · Written Communication

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Enhances productivity by 50% by building automation features in the financial web application for frequent tasks like approval process and e-mails.
- Optimizes financial web applications performance by 20% by refactoring legacy code by limiting library dependencies and minifying code.
- Migrates on-premise legacy applications and refactors from JavaScript and jQuery to Angular to ServiceNow cloud platform improving uptime by 90%.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · State Management · Software Development · jQuery · RESTful WebServices · Software Configuration Management · REST APIs · Code Review · AngularJS · Project Development · Section 508 · JavaScript · Problem Solving · JavaScript Frameworks · Web Applications · Product Delivery · Technical Leadership · Programming · Tailwind CSS · Front-End Development · English · Hands-on Technical · Version Control · Written Communication

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Improves World Wildlife Fund website by 15% by utilizing web development best practices that include accessibility, search engine optimization (SEO), and website performance.
- Leverages knowledge in web development, accessibility, and user interface design best practices to create accessible, usable websites and applications.
- Produces numerous fully-functional responsive websites and apps using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · State Management · Software Development · HTML · REST APIs · JavaScript · Problem Solving · JavaScript Frameworks · Web Applications · Product Delivery · Programming · Tailwind CSS · Vue.js · Front-End Development · Python (Programming Language) · English · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Hands-on Technical · Version Control · Written Communication

positions.title: Lead System Administrator
positions.description:
- Strategic oversight to all aspects of the entire system which effectively helped 100% success rate of various operations
- Efficient handling of maintenances and testing for network architecture and interconnectivity systems which successfully solved 90% of technical concerns
- Fulfillment of diverse tasks including daily maintenance and troubleshooting for numerous technical problems as well as use of Linux-based computer systems in performing operating system administration
- Pioneering of different systems in providing quicker engagements times in guaranteeing that safety goals would be achieved
- Key role in rendering support processes and workflow diagnosis to Forward Area Air Defense (Northrop Grumman), Portable Remote Control Station (Raytheon), Land-based Phalanx Weapons System (Raytheon), (AVS) AMDPCS Video System, and AN/MPQ-64A1 & A3 Sentinel Radar (Raytheon).
- Streamlining of several processes in battery and battalion levels which included Counter Rockets, Artillery, and Mortar; Standard Operating Procedures; and techniques, tactics, and procedures (TTP).
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Problem Solving · Air Defense · Bash · English · Hands-on Technical · Computer Networking
